text: A song of ascents.I raise my eyes toward the mountains. [1]From whence shall come my help? [AA]
My help comes from the Lord,the maker of heaven and earth. [AB]
He will not allow your foot to slip; [AC]or your guardian to sleep.
Behold, the guardian of Israelnever slumbers nor sleeps.
t[2]The Lord is your guardian;the Lord is your shadeat your right hand. [AD]
By day the sun will not strike you,nor the moon by night. [AE]
The Lord will guard you from all evil;he will guard your soul. [AF]
The Lord will guard your coming and goingboth now and forever. [AG]
